Use the browser find function (Ctrl+F or ⌘F). Official = you may cite. Course = lecture model. Industry usage = vocabulary, not Hong Kong law.

## At a glance

Four diagrams that summarise entries below. Each caption lists its sources; the entries themselves start at [Hong Kong institutions and law](#hong-kong-institutions-and-law).

### Altitude scale

```{mermaid}
%%{init: {"flowchart": {"nodeSpacing": 30, "rankSpacing": 26, "padding": 10, "wrappingWidth": 520}}}%%
flowchart BT
    G0["Ground level (真高 0)"]
    A1["<b>Hong Kong</b> · 100 ft above ground level (≈ 30 m)<br/>maximum flying altitude, Category A1"]
    A2["<b>Hong Kong</b> · 300 ft above ground level (≈ 91 m)<br/>maximum flying altitude, Category A2<br/>and exempted Category A1 models<br/>higher only with CAD permission (Cap. 448G s.37)"]
    M120["<b>Mainland</b> · 真高120米<br/>国令761 Art. 19: above 真高120米 = UAS 管制空域<br/>W类空域 = part of G类空域 below 真高120米<br/>(微型 / 轻型 / 小型 UAS)"]
    M300["<b>Mainland</b> · 真高300米<br/>G类空域 includes airspace below 真高300米<br/>outside B / C classes (W excluded)<br/>国令761 Art. 22: 小型 UAS 融合飞行<br/>up to 真高300米 needs ATM approval"]
    K1000["<b>Hong Kong</b> · about 1,000 m<br/>LAE = economic activities in airspace<br/>“generally below 1 000 metres”<br/>policy description, not a flying limit"]
    G0 --- A1 --- A2 --- M120 --- M300 --- K1000
    classDef hk fill:#f4f7fb,stroke:#003366,color:#1a1a1a
    classDef cn fill:#f8f6f1,stroke:#7a6a4f,color:#1a1a1a
    classDef pol fill:#ffffff,stroke:#003366,color:#1a1a1a
    classDef gnd fill:#e6e6e6,stroke:#555555,color:#1a1a1a
    class A1,A2 hk
    class M120,M300 cn
    class K1000 pol
    class G0 gnd
```

Sources (as of 6 Oct 2026): Category A1 100 ft and Category A2 300 ft above ground level, specified under Cap. 448G s.17(2) for s.16(1)(c) ([G.N. 1276 of 2022](https://www.cad.gov.hk/documents/G.N.1276_E.pdf); [Chinese](https://www.cad.gov.hk/documents/G.N.1276_C.pdf); [SRD §7.4.1](https://www.cad.gov.hk/documents/Safety_Requirements_Document.pdf); [AC-013 §6.1](https://www.cad.gov.hk/documents/AC-013_E.pdf)); exempted Category A1 models flown to the Category A2 operating requirements ([G.N. 2303 of 2022](https://www.cad.gov.hk/documents/G.N.2303_E.pdf)); permission under s.37 ([Cap. 448G](https://www.elegislation.gov.hk/hk/cap448G)); LAE as economic activities in airspace “generally below 1 000 metres” ([LegCo CB(3)933/2024](https://www.legco.gov.hk/yr2024/english/panels/edev/papers/edev20241203cb3-933-3-e.pdf); [2024 Policy Address ¶81](https://www.policyaddress.gov.hk/2024/en/p81.html)); 真高120米 管制空域 (Art. 19) and 真高300米 融合飞行 (Art. 22) ([国令761](https://www.gov.cn/zhengce/zhengceku/202306/content_6888800.htm)); G类 and W类空域 ([国家空域基础分类方法, CAAC](http://www.caac.gov.cn/XXGK/XXGK/TZTG/202312/t20231221_222397.html)).

Boxes are in height order but not to scale; Hong Kong metre figures are conversions (1 ft = 0.3048 m). The Mainland classification excludes the Hong Kong flight information region, so its labels are not Hong Kong law. Dashed, OPEN or PLANNED items are not established; this diagram has none.

### Weight ladder (Cap. 448G)

```{mermaid}
%%| column: page

flowchart LR

        A1 --- RA1
    end
    subgraph SA2[" "]
```

Sources (as of 6 Oct 2026): weight thresholds (s.3(2)), the 150 kg SUA ceiling (s.3(1)), s.10, s.11(1)(a)–(g) and s.37 ([Cap. 448G](https://www.elegislation.gov.hk/hk/cap448G); [Chinese](https://www.elegislation.gov.hk/hk/cap448G!zh-Hant-HK.pdf)); Category C from 18 July 2025 ([GIA, 17 Jul 2025](https://www.info.gov.hk/gia/general/202507/17/P2025071700590.htm)); rating types and the minimum age of 18 for Advanced Rating (C) ([SRD §5.1](https://www.cad.gov.hk/documents/Safety_Requirements_Document.pdf)); Cap. 448C provisions for trial operations of unconventional aircraft “under specified conditions” ([TLB LegCo reply, 24 Jun 2026](https://www.tlb.gov.hk/eng/legislative/transport/replies/2026/20260624a.html)); drafting to be completed within 2027 ([2026 Policy Address Annex, indicator 35](https://gia.info.gov.hk/general/202609/16/P2026091600270_557059_1_1789541487116.pdf); [2026 Policy Address ¶139](https://www.policyaddress.gov.hk/2026/en/chapter3.html)).

Each step adds to the ones on its left. A Category A1 flight that does not meet the s.10 conditions falls under the s.11 basic requirements. Any flight beyond the operating requirements, within a restricted flying zone or carrying dangerous goods needs a s.37 permission ([SRD §8.1](https://www.cad.gov.hk/documents/Safety_Requirements_Document.pdf)). Insurance (s.11(1)(c), s.12) is left out: CAD lists its effective date for standard operations as “to be determined” ([CAD](https://www.cad.gov.hk/english/sua_overview_regulatoryreq.html)). Dashed, OPEN or PLANNED items are not established: the over-150 kg legislation is PLANNED.

```{mermaid}
    E["<b>EVLOS</b> 延伸視線操作<br/>sight kept by the remote pilot and/or<br/>a visual observer <b>at a different location</b><br/>not routinely permitted"]
    B["<b>BVLOS</b> 超視距操作<br/>remote pilot or visual observer<br/><b>unable to maintain</b> visual line of sight"]
    SO["<b>Standard operation</b><br/>within the operating requirements<br/>(s.16(1)(b) VLOS in the specified way)<br/>no prior CAD permission"]

    V -->|"within all limits"| SO
    V -->|"Cat. B / C, or other<br/>limits exceeded"| AO
    E -->|"AC-004"| AO
    B -->|"Regulatory Sandbox<br/>(AC-013)"| AO
```

Sources (as of 6 Oct 2026): VLOS with a visual observer at the same location ([G.N. 1276 of 2022 ¶(2)](https://www.cad.gov.hk/documents/G.N.1276_E.pdf); [AC-013 §2.6.1](https://www.cad.gov.hk/documents/AC-013_E.pdf)); EVLOS with a visual observer at a different location, not routinely permitted, s.37 permission and Advanced Rating ([AC-004 §1.2–1.3, §2.3–2.4, §5.1](https://www.cad.gov.hk/documents/AC-004_E.pdf); [SRD §7.3](https://www.cad.gov.hk/documents/Safety_Requirements_Document.pdf)); BVLOS definition, Regulatory Sandbox applications, operator experience options and Advanced Rating ([AC-013 §2.6.2, §3.2, §4.2(a), §8.1](https://www.cad.gov.hk/documents/AC-013_E.pdf)); standard and advanced operations, rating types and the Advanced Operations Permission ([SRD §5.1.1, §8.1–8.3](https://www.cad.gov.hk/documents/Safety_Requirements_Document.pdf)); Chinese terms ([AC-013 Chinese §2.6](https://www.cad.gov.hk/documents/AC-013_C.pdf); [AC-004 Chinese](https://www.cad.gov.hk/documents/AC-004_C.pdf)).

The mapping is not one-to-one: a VLOS flight still needs permission and an Advanced Rating when it is an advanced operation, and the Advanced Operations Permission is one of two experience routes for a BVLOS operator, not a required step (AC-013 also says an operator without BVLOS experience may still be considered). This diagram covers BVLOS in the Regulatory Sandbox only; Sandbox X cross-boundary flights are under AC-017. Dashed, OPEN or PLANNED items are not established; this diagram has none.

UAV, VTOL and eVTOL are industry usage, as in their entries below.

No arrow joins the two groups: LAE and 低空经济 measure economic activity and are not aircraft categories. Dashed, OPEN or PLANNED items are not established: the dedicated unconventional-aircraft legislation is PLANNED.

## Hong Kong institutions and law

**Action Plan on Developing Low-Altitude Economy (發展低空經濟規劃行動綱領)**  
Kind: Official  
2025 PA ¶154; text OPEN. 2025 PA ¶154. Week 11–12.

::: {.callout-note collapse="true" appearance="simple" title="官方中英文本 · Official English and Chinese"}
English: “We will formulate the Action Plan on Developing Low-Altitude Economy to advance Hong Kong as a major hub for low-altitude applications through institutional innovations and technological breakthroughs.” ([source](https://www.policyaddress.gov.hk/2025/en/p153.html))

[「我們會制訂「發展低空經濟規劃行動綱領」，透過制度創新與技術突破，令香港成為低空創新應用的核心樞紐」]{lang="zh-Hant"} ([source](https://www.policyaddress.gov.hk/2025/tc/p153.html))
:::

**advanced operations (進階操作)**  
Kind: Official  
SUA operations that require prior CAD permission under Cap. 448G (as distinct from ordinary permitted flying). Cap. 448G / CAD. Week 7.

**Advanced Operations Permission (進階操作許可)**  
Kind: Official  
CAD permission under Cap. 448G s.37 to conduct an advanced operation (e.g. Sandbox BVLOS or Sandbox X cross-boundary). Cap. 448G s.37; CAD AC-013 §4.2; AC-017. Week 7.

**Advanced Rating (進階等級)**  
Kind: Official  
Rating assigned with a remote pilot certificate for more demanding SUA operations; AC-013 requires it for Sandbox BVLOS remote pilots. Cap. 448G; CAD AC-013 §8.1–8.2. Week 7.

**Advisory Circular (小型無人機通告)**  
Kind: Official  
CAD guidance document (e.g. AC-013 Sandbox BVLOS; AC-017 Sandbox X cross-boundary) — guidance, not Cap. 448G itself. CAD ACs. Week 7.

**ATMD (CAD)**  
Kind: Official  
CAD Air Traffic Management Division; AC-017 normally requires time-slot requests ≥5 working days before Sandbox X cross-boundary flights. CAD AC-017 §4.3. Week 8.

**CAD (民航處)**  
Kind: Official  
Hong Kong Civil Aviation Department — Cap. 448G regulator and issuer of sandbox Advisory Circulars. Cap. 448G; CAD. Week 1 / Week 7.

**Cap. 448C pathway (《1995年飛航（香港）令》（第448C章）)**  
Kind: Official  
Air Navigation (Hong Kong) Order 1995 — used with Cap. 448G when heavier / unconventional trial flying needs provisions outside the SUA Order alone. Cap. 448C; 2024–2025 PA LAE legislative track. Week 7 / Week 11.

**Dangerous goods (SUA) (危險品)**  
Kind: Official  
Goods or substances within Cap. 295 as applied by Cap. 448G; SUA must not carry them in flight unless permission is obtained. Cap. 448G; Cap. 295; CAD AC-013 §6.6. Week 7.

**Enclosed area (圍封範圍 / 圍封區域)**  
Kind: Official  
Official Chinese form 圍封範圍 / 圍封區域. Cap. 448G via AC-002_C / SRD (tc). Week 7.

**HKCA 1072**  
Kind: Official  
Do **not** map to the 1.4 GHz UAS (Private) Licence (GN-1/2025). HKCA 1072 Iss.2 (Aug 2026) is E-UTRA base station — different instrument. (WEEKLY-2026-09-05)

**LAE insurance task force**  
Kind: Official  
Industry group using Sandbox data. 2025 PA ¶157. Week 6.

::: {.callout-note collapse="true" appearance="simple" title="官方中英文本 · Official English and Chinese"}
English: “The insurance industry has set up a task force to develop low-altitude economy insurance products for various application scenarios, drawing reference from the data of the Government\'s Regulatory Sandbox.” ([source](https://www.policyaddress.gov.hk/2025/en/p156.html))

[「保險業界已成立專責小組，並會參考政府「監管沙盒」的數據，開發不同應用場景的低空經濟保險產品。」]{lang="zh-Hant"} ([source](https://www.policyaddress.gov.hk/2025/tc/p156.html))
:::

**OFCA / Communications Authority (通訊事務管理局)**  
Kind: Official  
Spectrum licensing authority for the UAS (Private) Licence (with the Communications Authority). OFCA / CA. Week 7.

**Operator (SUA) (營運人)**  
Kind: Official  
Official Chinese form 營運人. CAD AC-013_C §1.3. Week 7.

**Regulatory Sandbox (監管沙盒)**  
Kind: Official  
First-cohort Hong Kong trial programme. Applications from 13 November 2024; 38 of 72 proposals selected (TLB/GIA, 20 March 2025). BVLOS in this programme is covered by CAD AC-013. Week 1 / Week 7.

::: {.callout-note collapse="true" appearance="simple" title="官方中英文本 · Official English and Chinese"}
English: “The Government received Regulatory Sandbox pilot project proposals from 72 applicants, and after review by the Working Group on Developing LAE, 38 of them are among the first batch of pilot projects to be rolled out” ([source](https://www.info.gov.hk/gia/general/202503/20/P2025032000179.htm))

[「政府共接獲由72個申請者提交的「監管沙盒」試點項目申請，經發展低空經濟工作組審閱後，其中38項成為首批推展的試點項目」]{lang="zh-Hant"} ([source](https://www.info.gov.hk/gia/general/202503/20/P2025032000178.htm))
:::

**Regulatory Sandbox X (監管沙盒 X / 監管沙盒X)**  
Kind: Official  
Advanced programme launched 24 November 2025. Separate from the first Sandbox. Module batches reported as UTM 15, unconventional aircraft 4, shared platform 5, others 9; cross-boundary results still open. CAD AC-017 covers cross-boundary operations in Sandbox X. Week 1 / Week 7.

::: {.callout-note collapse="true" appearance="simple" title="官方中英文本 · Official English and Chinese"}
English: “The launch event of the low-altitude economy \"Regulatory Sandbox X\" was held today (November 24), with an aim to further promoting the development of low-altitude economy in Hong Kong and exploring innovative applications.” ([source](https://www.info.gov.hk/gia/general/202511/24/P2025112400912.htm))

[「低空經濟「監管沙盒X」啟動禮今日（十一月二十四日）舉行，旨在進一步推動香港的低空經濟發展，並探索創新應用場景。」]{lang="zh-Hant"} ([source](https://www.info.gov.hk/gia/general/202511/24/P2025112400779.htm))

English: “(i) 15 pilot projects under the UTM system demonstrations module, (ii) a first batch of four pilot projects under the unconventional aircraft module; (iii) a first batch of five pilot projects under the multiple applications/users shared-platform module; and (iv) a first batch of nine pilot projects under the others module have been selected for implementation in phases.” ([source](https://www.tlb.gov.hk/eng/highlights/transport/low-altitude.html))

[「經發展低空經濟工作組審閱後，已選定(i) 15個UTM系統演示試點項目；(ii) 首批四個非傳統航空器試點項目；(iii) 首批五個多場景／多用戶共享平台試點項目，以及(iv) 首批九個其他試點項目予以分階段推行。」]{lang="zh-Hant"} ([source](https://www.tlb.gov.hk/tc/highlights/transport/low-altitude.html))
:::

**Remote pilot certificate (遙控駕駛員證書)**  
Kind: Official  
Certificate issued under Cap. 448G after required training/assessment for registered remote pilots. Cap. 448G; CAD AC-013 §8. Week 7.

**Responsible person (負責人)**  
Kind: Official  
Person responsible for the SUA under Cap. 448G (registration/labelling and compliance duties alongside the remote pilot). Cap. 448G. Week 7.

**Safety Requirements Document (SRD) (《安全規定文件》 / 《小型無人機安全規定文件》)**  
Kind: Official  
CAD document issued under Cap. 448G s.63 setting detailed SUA safety requirements; ACs are read with the Order and the SRD. Cap. 448G s.63; CAD AC-013 §18.2; AC-017 §11.2. Week 7.

**Small Unmanned Aircraft Order, Cap. 448G (《小型無人機令》（第448G章）)**  
Kind: Official  
Hong Kong statute for small unmanned aircraft. Full effect 1 December 2022; Category C up to 150 kg from 18 July 2025. Week 7.

::: {.callout-note collapse="true" appearance="simple" title="官方中英文本 · Official English and Chinese"}
English: “Under the SUA Order that took full effect on 1 December 2022, SUA operations are regulated under a risk-based approach.”…“In July 2025, the scope of the SUA Order was expanded to cover SUA weighing not more than 150kg.” ([source](https://www.cad.gov.hk/english/sua.html))

[「法例已於2022年12月1日全面實施，以風險為本的模式規管小型無人機的操作」…「於2025年7月， 《小型無人機令》的規管制度擴闊至重量不超過150公斤的小型無人機。」]{lang="zh-Hant"} ([source](https://www.cad.gov.hk/chinese/sua.html))
:::

**Standard Rating (標準等級)**  
Kind: Official  
Official Chinese form 標準等級. CAD SRD (tc) §5.1.1. Week 7.

**Supporting crew (輔助人員)**  
Kind: Official  
Official Chinese form 輔助人員. CAD AC-013_C §4.3(b), §8.4. Week 7.

**TLB (運輸及物流局)**  
Kind: Official  
Transport and Logistics Bureau; policy bureau supporting the Working Group secretariat and LAE sandbox communications. TLB / WG materials. Week 1.

**Unconventional aircraft (非傳統飛行器)**  
Kind: Official  
Intended dedicated rules for craft over 150 kg; legislation OPEN. 2025 PA ¶154. Week 7.

::: {.callout-note collapse="true" appearance="simple" title="官方中英文本 · Official English and Chinese"}
English: “Improve civil aviation legislation and regulatory framework, including formulating dedicated legislation for unconventional aircraft weighing over 150 kilograms, to lay the foundation for developing the standardisation of the low-altitude economy.” ([source](https://www.policyaddress.gov.hk/2025/en/p153.html))

[「完善民航法例及規管框架，為重量超過150公斤的「非傳統飛行器」制訂專用法例，為低空經濟標準化發展奠下基礎。」]{lang="zh-Hant"} ([source](https://www.policyaddress.gov.hk/2025/tc/p153.html))
:::

**Unmanned Aircraft Office (CAD) (無人駕駛飛機組)**  
Kind: Official  
Official Chinese form 無人駕駛飛機組. CAD AC-013_C §18.3. Week 7.

**Working Group on Developing Low-altitude Economy (發展低空經濟工作組)**  
Kind: Official  
Cross-government group headed by the Deputy Financial Secretary; first meeting 2024-11-12. 2024 PA ¶82; GIA 2024-11-12. Week 1.

::: {.callout-note collapse="true" appearance="simple" title="官方中英文本 · Official English and Chinese"}
English: “The Government will establish the Working Group on Developing Low-altitude Economy. Led by the Deputy Financial Secretary, it will formulate development strategies and inter-departmental action plans” ([source](https://www.policyaddress.gov.hk/2024/en/p81.html))

[「政府將成立「發展低空經濟工作組」，由財政司副司長任組長，制訂發展策略和跨部門行動計劃」]{lang="zh-Hant"} ([source](https://www.policyaddress.gov.hk/2024/tc/p81.html))

English: “The Chief Executive announced in the 2024 Policy Address to establish the Working Group on Developing Low-altitude Economy (the Working Group). The Deputy Financial Secretary, Mr Michael Wong, convened the first meeting as the Head of the Working Group today (November 12).” ([source](https://www.info.gov.hk/gia/general/202411/12/P2024111200260.htm))

[「行政長官在二○二四年《施政報告》宣布成立「發展低空經濟工作組」（工作組），財政司副司長黃偉綸今日（十一月十二日）以組長身分召開工作組的首次會議。」]{lang="zh-Hant"} ([source](https://www.info.gov.hk/gia/general/202411/12/P2024111200288.htm))

## Mainland comparators

**CAAC ATM Rules (draft) (《民用航空空中交通管理规则（征求意见稿）》)**  
Kind: Official  
NEW watch term. Published **2026-08-11**; comments to **2026-09-11**; Chapter 12 无人驾驶航空器. Not yet law. (WEEKLY-2026-09-05)

::: {.callout-note collapse="true" appearance="simple" title="原文 · Chinese original"}
[「中国民用航空局修订了《民用航空空中交通管理规则》，形成《民用航空空中交通管理规则（征求意见稿）》，现向社会公开征求意见。」…「意见反馈截止时间为2026年9月11日。」]{lang="zh-Hans"} ([source](https://www.caac.gov.cn/HDJL/YJZJ/202608/t20260811_231462.html))
:::

**CCAR-92 (《民用无人驾驶航空器运行安全管理规则》)**  
Kind: Official  
CAAC civil aviation regulation on UAS operational safety; effective **2024-01-01**. CCAR-92 / MOT publication. Week 7.

::: {.callout-note collapse="true" appearance="simple" title="原文 · Chinese original"}
[「已于2023年12月15日经第29次部务会议通过，现予公布，自公布之日起施行。」…「2024年1月1日」]{lang="zh-Hans"} ([source](https://xxgk.mot.gov.cn/2020/jigou/fgs/202401/t20240103_3980642.html))
:::

**Civil Aviation Law (2025 revision) (《中华人民共和国民用航空法》（2025年修订）)**  
Kind: Official  
Revised PRC Civil Aviation Law (Order No. 65); passed 2025-12-27; effective **2026-07-01**; detailed UAS operating rules still rest on State Council / CAAC instruments until further rules are made. Order No. 65; CAAC. Week 7.

::: {.callout-note collapse="true" appearance="simple" title="官方中英文本 · Official English and Chinese"}
English: “Order of the President of the People\'s Republic of China (No. 65)”…“The Civil Aviation Law of the People\'s Republic of China, revised and adopted at the 19th Session of the Standing Committee of the Fourteenth National People\'s Congress of the People\'s Republic of China on December 27, 2025, is hereby promulgated and shall come into effect on July 1, 2026.” ([source](https://www.caac.gov.cn/English/News/202512/t20251230_229616.html))

[「中华人民共和国主席令第六十五号」…「2025年12月27日第十四届全国人民代表大会常务委员会第十九次会议修订」…「第二百六十二条　本法自2026年7月1日起施行。」]{lang="zh-Hans"} ([source](https://www.caac.gov.cn/XXGK/XXGK/FLFG/202512/t20251227_229597.html))
:::

**Class G / W (G类 / W类空域)**  
Kind: Official  
Mainland national airspace classification labels (2023 release); **not Hong Kong law**. CAAC National Airspace Basic Classification (2023-12-21). Week 8.

::: {.callout-note collapse="true" appearance="simple" title="原文 · Chinese original"}
[「为充分利用国家空域资源，规范空域划设和管理使用，国家空管委组织制定了《国家空域基础分类方法》，现予以发布。」]{lang="zh-Hans"} ([source](http://www.caac.gov.cn/XXGK/XXGK/TZTG/202312/t20231221_222397.html))
:::

**低空经济**  
Hong Kong: 低空經濟
Kind: Official  
Mainland statistical and industrial-policy scope per NDRC 发改低空〔2025〕1676号 (2025-12-22) — **not** the same metric as OHKF Hong Kong industry value-added. NDRC 发改低空〔2025〕1676号. Week 1 / Week 9.

::: {.callout-note collapse="true" appearance="simple" title="原文 · Chinese original"}
[「为明确低空经济概念和范畴，明晰产业边界，根据低空经济阶段性特征和重点领域、重点环节，按照统计工作相关规定，编制形成《低空经济及其核心产业统计分类（试行）》。现印发你们，请按此执行。」]{lang="zh-Hans"} ([source](https://www.gov.cn/zhengce/zhengceku/202512/content_7052866.htm))
:::

Kind: Official  
State Council Interim UAS Flight Management Ordinance; effective **2024-01-01** — Mainland ops baseline with CCAR-92. 国令761. Week 7.

::: {.callout-note collapse="true" appearance="simple" title="原文 · Chinese original"}
[「现公布《无人驾驶航空器飞行管理暂行条例》，自2024年1月1日起施行。」]{lang="zh-Hans"} ([source](https://www.gov.cn/zhengce/zhengceku/202306/content_6888800.htm))
:::

## Vehicles and operations

**300 ft AGL operating limit (飛行高度不高於地面以上 300 呎)**  
Kind: Official  
Maximum flying altitude for Category A2 SUA (and exempted Category A1 models flown to Category A2 requirements): 300 ft above ground level; Category A1's limit is 100 ft. Higher only with CAD permission under Cap. 448G s.37. G.N. 1276 of 2022; SRD §7.4.1; CAD AC-013 §6.1. Week 7.

**Air risk (空中風險)**  
Kind: Official  
Risk of collision or conflict with other airspace users during the SUA flight. CAD AC-013 §4.3(f). Week 7 / Week 8.

**Automatic operation (自動操作)**  
Kind: Official  
SUA follows pre-determined routes, but the remote pilot must still be able to intervene for unforeseen events. CAD AC-013 §2.1. Week 7.

**Autonomous operation (自主操作)**  
Kind: Official  
SUA flies without the remote pilot being able to intervene; **not allowed** for Sandbox BVLOS under AC-013. CAD AC-013 §2.2, §6.7. Week 7.

**BVLOS (超視距操作)**  
Kind: Official  
Operation beyond the remote pilot’s visual line of sight; in the first Regulatory Sandbox, the relevant circular is CAD AC-013. CAD AC-013; Cap. 448G. Week 7.

**C2 link (指揮和與控制數據鏈路)**  
Kind: Official  
Command-and-control communications link between the remote pilot / ground systems and the SUA. CAD AC-013 §5.5; AC-017 §5. Week 7 / Week 8.

**Category A1 / A2 / B / C (甲一類 / 甲二類 / 乙類 / 丙類)**  
Kind: Official  
Weight-based SUA classes under Cap. 448G; Category C covers above 25 kg up to 150 kg (from 2025-07-18). Cap. 448G s.2, s.3(2) (Cat C expansion 2025-07-18). Week 7.

::: {.callout-note collapse="true" appearance="simple" title="官方中英文本 · Official English and Chinese"}
English: “The amendments to the Small Unmanned Aircraft (SUA) Order (Cap. 448G) serve to extend the existing regulatory regime to cover SUA weighing over 25 kilograms but not exceeding 150kg.”…“The Small Unmanned Aircraft (Amendment) Order 2025 and the Air Navigation (Hong Kong) Order 1995 (Amendment) Order 2025 will come into effect tomorrow (July 18) to facilitate the development of the low-altitude economy.” ([source](https://www.info.gov.hk/gia/general/202507/17/P2025071700590.htm))

[「修訂《小型無人機令》（第448G章）旨在擴闊現行規管制度，以涵蓋重量超過25公斤但不超過150公斤的小型無人機。」…「《2025年小型無人機（修訂）令》和《2025年〈1995年飛航（香港）令〉（修訂）令》，將於明日（七月十八日）生效，以推動低空經濟的發展。」]{lang="zh-Hant"} ([source](https://www.info.gov.hk/gia/general/202507/17/P2025071700589.htm))
:::

**Congested area (人口稠密區域 / 人口密集區域)**  
Kind: Official  
Built-up area where BVLOS routes that raise ground risk should normally be avoided unless justified to CAD. CAD AC-013 §5.2; Cap. 448G operating context. Week 7.

**Containment**  
Kind: Official  
Keeping the SUA entirely inside the pre-defined sandbox operating areas or routes by technology and/or procedures. CAD AC-013 §4.3(d), §5.3. Week 7 / Week 8.

**Cross-boundary SUA operation (跨境小型無人機操作 / 跨境操作)**  
Kind: Official  
SUA flight that is **not** wholly within Hong Kong; Cap. 448G treats it as an advanced operation needing CAD permission — AC-017 covers Sandbox X cross-boundary (no person on board). Cap. 448G s.16(1A); CAD AC-017. Week 7 / Week 8.

**Daylight-only default (只限日間時間操作)**  
Kind: Official  
Default operating requirement to fly SUA only in daylight hours unless a relevant permission is obtained. Cap. 448G / SRD; CAD AC-013 §6.1. Week 7.

**Detect and avoid (探測與避障)**  
Kind: Official  
Capability to see, sense or detect conflicting traffic or other hazards and take appropriate action — concept only, no product brand. CAD AC-013 §2.3. Week 7 / Week 8.

**docking station (無人機機庫)**  
Kind: Industry usage  
Ground unit for automated launch, recovery, charging or swapping of small unmanned aircraft; CAD AC-016 addresses hangar/dock-style SUA operations — **not** a vertiport statute. CAD AC-016; industry usage. Week 5 / Week 7.

::: {.callout-note collapse="true" appearance="simple" title="官方中英文本 · Official English and Chinese"}
English: “Guidelines and Permission for Small Unmanned Aircraft Operations Using Unmanned Aircraft Docking Station” ([source](https://www.cad.gov.hk/documents/AC-016.pdf))

[「使用無人機機庫進行小型無人機操作的指引及許可」]{lang="zh-Hant"} ([source](https://www.cad.gov.hk/documents/AC-016_C.pdf))
:::

**EVLOS (延伸視線操作)**  
Kind: Official  
Operation beyond simple VLOS but still using visual observers or procedures — not BVLOS. CAD / Cap. 448G practice. Week 7.

**eVTOL (電動垂直起降飛行器)**  
Kind: Industry usage  
Electric vertical take-off and landing aircraft; in Hong Kong, passenger-carrying / heavy types sit above the Cap. 448G 150 kg SUA ceiling and are treated as unconventional aircraft pending dedicated rules — **no dedicated HK eVTOL statute yet**. Cap. 448G ceiling; 2025 PA ¶154 unconventional-aircraft pathway (OPEN). Week 7 / Week 5.

::: {.callout-note collapse="true" appearance="simple" title="官方中英文本 · Official English and Chinese"}
English: “Improve civil aviation legislation and regulatory framework, including formulating dedicated legislation for unconventional aircraft weighing over 150 kilograms, to lay the foundation for developing the standardisation of the low-altitude economy.” ([source](https://www.policyaddress.gov.hk/2025/en/p153.html))

[「完善民航法例及規管框架，為重量超過150公斤的「非傳統飛行器」制訂專用法例，為低空經濟標準化發展奠下基礎。」]{lang="zh-Hant"} ([source](https://www.policyaddress.gov.hk/2025/tc/p153.html))
:::

**Fail-safe mechanism (失效安全機制)**  
Kind: Official  
Official Chinese form 失效安全機制. CAD AC-013_C App. A §3.7. Week 7.

**Flight critical system (飛行關鍵系統)**  
Kind: Official  
System whose failure could be catastrophic or stop the SUA sustaining flight (e.g. flight control, propulsion, navigation). CAD AC-013 §2.4. Week 7.

**Flight log (飛行記錄)**  
Kind: Official  
Required safety-system record of flight data; AC-013 requires retention (with other safety-system info) for six months and accessibility in Hong Kong for advanced operations. Cap. 448G s.13; CAD AC-013 §10.1. Week 7.

**Flight termination (飛行終止 / 終止飛行)**  
Kind: Official  
Procedure or system that ends the flight as soon as practicable in an emergency. CAD AC-013 §9.4. Week 7.

**Flyaway (飛失)**  
Kind: Official  
Official Chinese form 飛失. CAD AC-013_C §14.1(f). Week 7.

**Geo-awareness (適飛空域辨識)**  
Kind: Official  
SUA safety-system function that supports awareness of geographical limits; required with flight log under Cap. 448G s.13 / AC-013. Cap. 448G s.13; CAD AC-013 §10.1. Week 7.

**Geo-fence / geo-fencing (電子圍欄)**  
Kind: Official  
Electronic or procedural boundary that keeps the SUA inside pre-defined sandbox operating areas or flight routes. CAD AC-013 §5.3, App. A §3.6. Week 7 / Week 8.

**Ground risk (地面風險)**  
Kind: Official  
Risk to people, vehicles, vessels or structures on the ground from the SUA flight. CAD AC-013 §4.3(f), §5.2. Week 7.

**Interoperability / standards**  
Kind: Course  
Ability of vehicles, UTM and sites to work to a common rule set; cite PA infrastructure language only. Course / 2025 PA. Week 11–12.

**Involved person (參與人員)**  
Kind: Official  
Person who takes part in or is briefed on the SUA operation, understands the risks, and follows safety instructions. CAD AC-013 §2.5.1. Week 7.

**MTOW**  
Kind: Official  
Maximum certified take-off weight; Cap. 448G categories and Mainland UAS rules key off weight thresholds. Cap. 448G; Mainland UAS instruments. Week 7.

**Operations Manual (操作手冊)**  
Kind: Official  
Operator document setting organisation, procedures, emergency response and maintenance for the proposed advanced / sandbox operation. CAD AC-013 App. A; AC-017 §9.1. Week 7.

**payload (載荷)**  
Kind: Course  
Mass or cargo carried for the mission, distinct from empty weight or MTOW. Course. Week 3 / Week 7.

**Remote ID**  
Kind: Official  
Continuous broadcast of SUA identity and geographic position so aircraft in the air can be identified. CAD AC-017 §8.2. Week 7 / Week 8.

**Remote pilot (遙控駕駛員)**  
Kind: Official  
Person who manipulates the flight controls of a SUA during flight under Cap. 448G. Cap. 448G; CAD AC-013 §7. Week 7.

**Return-to-home (自動返航 / 返航點)**  
Kind: Official  
Pre-programmed recovery behaviour that sends the SUA to a home or safe site (e.g. after C2-link loss); incorrect RTH settings are a containment hazard. CAD AC-013 §14.1. Week 7.

**Specific Operations Risk Assessment (SORA) (特定運行風險評估)**  
Kind: Official  
Official Chinese form 特定運行風險評估. CAD AC-013_C App. B (names SORA). Week 7.

**SUA (小型無人機)**  
Mainland: 无人驾驶航空器
Kind: Official  
Hong Kong Cap. 448G term for small unmanned aircraft in the Order’s weight classes — not a global synonym for every drone. Cap. 448G. Week 7.

**Surveillance system (監察系統)**  
Kind: Official  
Means (or alternative compliance) for the remote pilot to monitor the SUA and nearby traffic/obstacles during higher-risk BVLOS. CAD AC-013 §10.9. Week 7 / Week 8.

**UAS**  
Kind: Official  
Unmanned aircraft system (aircraft + control station + links); used in OFCA licence titles and Mainland instruments; broader than Cap. 448G “SUA.”. OFCA UAS (Private) Licence; Mainland 国令761 / CCAR-92 usage. Week 7.

**UAV**  
Kind: Industry usage  
Common label for the aircraft alone; prefer **SUA** when citing Cap. 448G and **UAS** when citing system or spectrum rules. Course / industry usage. Week 7.

**Uninvolved person (非參與人員)**  
Kind: Official  
Any person other than an involved person; drives ground-risk planning for BVLOS. CAD AC-013 §2.5.2. Week 7.

**Visual observer (視像觀察員)**  
Kind: Official  
Person at the same location as the remote pilot who keeps unaided visual contact with the SUA and communicates to help avoid collision. CAD AC-013 §2.6.1; official Chinese form 視像觀察員 in [G.N. 1276 ¶(2)](https://www.cad.gov.hk/documents/G.N.1276_C.pdf) and CAD AC-013_C §2.6.1. Week 7.

**VLOS (視線內操作)**  
Kind: Official  
Operation in which the remote pilot (or observer) keeps the aircraft in unaided visual sight. Cap. 448G / CAD. Week 7.

**VTOL**  
Kind: Industry usage  
Vertical take-off and landing as a flight capability, whether electric or not; broader than eVTOL. Course / industry usage. Week 7.

## Airspace and traffic

**Aerodrome Traffic Zone (機場交通區)**  
Kind: Official  
Official Chinese form 機場交通區. CAD AC-013_C §5.1(d). Week 8.

**Air Traffic Control (航空交通管制)**  
Kind: Official  
Official Chinese form 航空交通管制. CAD AC-013_C §7.4(f). Week 8.

**corridor**  
Kind: Industry usage  
A defined low-altitude route volume used in policy and sandbox language (including cross-boundary concepts); a planned or trial corridor is not proof of an operating SZ–HK medical corridor. Sandbox X / TLB cross-boundary language; Tracker: corridor **operational** NOT evidenced. Week 8 / Week 4.

**Government Flying Service (政府飛行服務隊)**  
Kind: Official  
Official Chinese form 政府飛行服務隊. CAD AC-013_C §5.1(f). Week 8.

**HKAIP special-use airspace (《香港航空資料匯編》…禁區／限制區／危險區)**  
Kind: Official  
Prohibited, Restricted or Danger Areas published in the Hong Kong Aeronautical Information Publication — Sandbox BVLOS routes must stay clear unless justified. CAD AC-013 §5.1; HKAIP. Week 8.

**Prohibited / Restricted / Danger Area (HKAIP) (禁區／限制區／危險區)**  
Kind: Official  
Official Chinese form 禁區／限制區／危險區. CAD AC-013_C §5.1(b). Week 8.

**restricted flying zone (限制飛行區)**  
Kind: Official  
CAD-designated area where SUA flight is restricted or needs permission; cite current CAD maps/notices, not press maps. CAD; official Chinese form 限制飛行區 in Cap. 448G s.2. Week 7 / Week 8.

**Smart low-altitude traffic management (智能低空交通管理系統)**  
Kind: Official  
Policy-Address label for the planned digital traffic-management layer of low-altitude infrastructure; Hong Kong system still **planned**, not a statute. 2024 PA LAE infra slide; 2025 PA ¶154. Week 8 / Week 5.

::: {.callout-note collapse="true" appearance="simple" title="官方中英文本 · Official English and Chinese"}
English: “Enhance core infrastructure facilities by designating spectrum by the end of the year, as well as facilitating early planning and deployment of facilities such as vertiports, air route networks, satellite positioning, three-dimensional spatial data systems and a smart, low-altitude traffic-management system.” ([source](https://www.policyaddress.gov.hk/2025/en/p153.html))

[「推展核心基建設施，年底前推出專用頻譜，提前規劃部署起降場、航路網絡、衞星定位、三維空間數據系統、智能低空交通管理系統等。」]{lang="zh-Hant"} ([source](https://www.policyaddress.gov.hk/2025/tc/p153.html))
:::

**U-space**  
Kind: Industry usage  
EU / industry label for a set of UAS traffic services; **not Hong Kong law** — do not write that Hong Kong has U-space. EU U-space framework (industry comparator). Week 8.

**UTM**  
Kind: Industry usage  
Unmanned aircraft system traffic management; Hong Kong’s smart low-altitude traffic-management system is **planned** infrastructure (2025 PA) — **not yet a Hong Kong statute**. 2025 PA ¶154; Sandbox X UTM demos. Week 8.

::: {.callout-note collapse="true" appearance="simple" title="官方中英文本 · Official English and Chinese"}
English: “Enhance core infrastructure facilities by designating spectrum by the end of the year, as well as facilitating early planning and deployment of facilities such as vertiports, air route networks, satellite positioning, three-dimensional spatial data systems and a smart, low-altitude traffic-management system.” ([source](https://www.policyaddress.gov.hk/2025/en/p153.html))

[「推展核心基建設施，年底前推出專用頻譜，提前規劃部署起降場、航路網絡、衞星定位、三維空間數據系統、智能低空交通管理系統等。」]{lang="zh-Hant"} ([source](https://www.policyaddress.gov.hk/2025/tc/p153.html))
:::

**visual line of sight (視線內)**  
Kind: Official  
Plain-language pair to VLOS: keeping the aircraft in unaided sight; use the VLOS entry for Cap. 448G citations. Cap. 448G / CAD. Week 7.

## Infrastructure

**1.4 GHz / UAS**  
Kind: Official  
Dedicated UAS spectrum band 1430–1444 MHz, licensable for LAE Regulatory Sandbox projects from 2025-10-27 — not a general public mobile band. CA / OFCA; GN-1/2025. Week 7.

::: {.callout-note collapse="true" appearance="simple" title="官方中英文本 · Official English and Chinese"}
English: “The Communications Authority has made available the 1430 – 1444 MHz band (1.4 GHz band) for use by UAS and created a new licence to facilitate the use of the dedicated spectrum.”…“At present, the 1.4 GHz band is confined to be used by projects under the LAE Regulatory Sandbox launched by the Government.”…“the Unmanned Aircraft System (Private) Licence has been created since 27 October 2025” ([source](https://www.ofca.gov.hk/en/industry_focus/industry_focus/uas_private_licence/index.html))

[「通訊事務管理局（通訊局） 已規劃1430 – 1444 兆赫頻帶（1.4 吉赫頻帶）供無人機系統使用，並設立新的牌照以促進該專用頻譜的使用。」…「目前，1.4 吉赫頻帶只限於香港低空經濟監管沙盒項目使用。」…「無人駕駛飛機系統（專用）牌照於2025年10月27日設立」]{lang="zh-Hant"} ([source](https://www.ofca.gov.hk/tc/industry_focus/industry_focus/uas_private_licence/index.html))
:::

**charging / swapping (充電站 (PA infra list))**  
Kind: Course  
Energy logistics for electric SUA or eVTOL at sites or docks; course infrastructure concept, not a licence by itself. Course. Week 5.

**Dedicated spectrum (PA) (專用頻譜)**  
Kind: Official  
Official Chinese form 專用頻譜. 2025 PA ¶154. Week 7 / Week 8.

**GNSS (全球導航衞星系統)**  
Kind: Official  
Official Chinese form 全球導航衞星系統. CAD AC-013_C §5.5. Week 7 / Week 8.

**Low-altitude infrastructure (低空基礎建設 / 低空基礎設施)**  
Kind: Official  
PA package covering GNSS, mobile radio, high-speed data, take-off/landing and charging facilities, plus traffic management — planning language, not a built network inventory. 2024 PA LAE; 2025 PA ¶154–155. Week 5 / Week 8.

::: {.callout-note collapse="true" appearance="simple" title="官方中英文本 · Official English and Chinese"}
English: “Enhance core infrastructure facilities by designating spectrum by the end of the year, as well as facilitating early planning and deployment of facilities such as vertiports, air route networks, satellite positioning, three-dimensional spatial data systems and a smart, low-altitude traffic-management system.” ([source](https://www.policyaddress.gov.hk/2025/en/p153.html))

[「推展核心基建設施，年底前推出專用頻譜，提前規劃部署起降場、航路網絡、衞星定位、三維空間數據系統、智能低空交通管理系統等。」]{lang="zh-Hant"} ([source](https://www.policyaddress.gov.hk/2025/tc/p153.html))
:::

**Route network (PA) (航路網絡)**  
Kind: Official  
Official Chinese form 航路網絡. 2025 PA ¶154. Week 5 / Week 8.

**Satellite positioning (PA) (衞星定位)**  
Kind: Official  
Official Chinese form 衞星定位. 2025 PA ¶154. Week 5 / Week 8.

**Three-dimensional spatial data system (PA) (三維空間數據系統)**  
Kind: Official  
Official Chinese form 三維空間數據系統. 2025 PA ¶154. Week 5 / Week 8.

**Throughput**  
Kind: Course  
Movements a site can handle per hour after safety separation. Course. Week 5.

**Vertiport (起降場)**  
Kind: Industry usage  
Take-off and landing site for advanced low-altitude craft; 2025 Policy Address names planning of such sites — **Hong Kong has no dedicated vertiport statute yet** (do not invent one). 2025 PA ¶154; text of Action Plan OPEN. Week 5.

::: {.callout-note collapse="true" appearance="simple" title="官方中英文本 · Official English and Chinese"}
English: “Enhance core infrastructure facilities by designating spectrum by the end of the year, as well as facilitating early planning and deployment of facilities such as vertiports, air route networks, satellite positioning, three-dimensional spatial data systems and a smart, low-altitude traffic-management system.” ([source](https://www.policyaddress.gov.hk/2025/en/p153.html))

[「推展核心基建設施，年底前推出專用頻譜，提前規劃部署起降場、航路網絡、衞星定位、三維空間數據系統、智能低空交通管理系統等。」]{lang="zh-Hant"} ([source](https://www.policyaddress.gov.hk/2025/tc/p153.html))
:::

**vertistop**  
Kind: Industry usage  
Industry term for a lighter pad than a full vertiport; **not a Hong Kong statutory category**. Industry usage. Week 5.

## Business and economics

**ASK / available capacity unit**  
Kind: Course  
Capacity supplied (seat-km or payload-km) used as the denominator in CASK/CPMK — course accounting identity only; no lecture numbers on the public site. Course models (W3). Week 3.

**Break-even load factor**  
Kind: Course  
Load factor at which revenue covers a stated cost block; course planning tool — worked classroom numbers stay off the public site. Course models (W3). Week 3.

**CAPEX / OPEX**  
Kind: Course  
Upfront capital expenditure versus recurring operating expenditure. Course. Week 3.

**CASK / CPMK**  
Kind: Course  
Cost per available seat-kilometre or per available payload-kilometre — lecture worked examples are not data. Course. Week 3.

**economies of density**  
Kind: Course  
Average cost falls as more flights share the same corridor or vertiport. Course. Week 2.

**externality**  
Kind: Course  
Noise, risk, privacy or carbon cost not priced into the ticket or fee. Course. Week 10.

**generalised cost**  
Kind: Course  
Money cost plus time valued at the traveller’s value of time. Course. Week 4.

**HHI**  
Kind: Course  
Sum of squared market shares; classroom calculations stay off the public site. Course. Week 2.

**Industry value-added**  
Kind: Course  
Accounting concept used by Our Hong Kong Foundation for the ~HK$350 billion figure: Hong Kong only, horizon 2050, September 2025 report. Not government output and not a Mainland 规模 total. Week 1 / Week 9.

::: {.callout-note collapse="true" appearance="simple" title="官方中英文本 · Official English and Chinese"}
English: “Based on the latest publicly available data, the industry value added of the LAE in Hong Kong will reach approximately HK\$ 350 billion in 2050, with the majority of value generated in supporting services.” ([source](https://ourhkfoundation.org.hk/en/events/%E3%80%8A%E6%8C%AF%E7%BF%85%E5%95%9F%E8%88%AA-%E2%80%94-%E9%96%8B%E5%89%B5%E9%A6%99%E6%B8%AF%E4%BD%8E%E7%A9%BA%E7%B6%93%E6%BF%9F%E6%96%B0%E6%9C%AA%E4%BE%86%E3%80%8B%E5%A0%B1%E5%91%8A%E7%99%BC%E5%B8%83%E6%9C%83))

[「根據本報告撰寫時的最新公開數據估算，預計到2050年，本港低空經濟產業的增加價值將達到約3,500億港元，而其中大部分來自配套服務。」]{lang="zh-Hant"} ([source](https://ourhkfoundation.org.hk/tc/events/%E3%80%8A%E6%8C%AF%E7%BF%85%E5%95%9F%E8%88%AA-%E2%80%94-%E9%96%8B%E5%89%B5%E9%A6%99%E6%B8%AF%E4%BD%8E%E7%A9%BA%E7%B6%93%E6%BF%9F%E6%96%B0%E6%9C%AA%E4%BE%86%E3%80%8B%E5%A0%B1%E5%91%8A%E7%99%BC%E5%B8%83%E6%9C%83))
:::

**load factor**  
Kind: Course  
Traffic carried divided by capacity offered (seats or payload). Course. Week 3.

**NASA UAM market study constraints**  
Kind: Course  
Legal, weather, infrastructure and acceptance shrink the unconstrained market. NASA 2018. Week 4.

**Pigovian instrument**  
Kind: Course  
Tax, charge or subsidy aimed at that externality; Hong Kong has no drone congestion tax in force. Course. Week 10.

**platform / FaaS**  
Kind: Course  
Matching or fly-as-a-service model, as distinct from owning the fleet. Course. Week 6.

**PPP**  
Kind: Course  
Public–private partnership for infrastructure or services — **not** a substitute for a vertiport statute. Course. Week 5 / Week 11.

**Social license**  
Kind: Course  
Informal community acceptance that can constrain routes even when legal permission exists. Course models (W10). Week 10.

**Supporting services**  
Kind: Industry usage  
The segment that accounts for most of the 2050 value-added projection. OHKF. Week 1.

::: {.callout-note collapse="true" appearance="simple" title="官方中英文本 · Official English and Chinese"}
English: “Based on the latest publicly available data, the industry value added of the LAE in Hong Kong will reach approximately HK\$ 350 billion in 2050, with the majority of value generated in supporting services.” ([source](https://ourhkfoundation.org.hk/en/events/%E3%80%8A%E6%8C%AF%E7%BF%85%E5%95%9F%E8%88%AA-%E2%80%94-%E9%96%8B%E5%89%B5%E9%A6%99%E6%B8%AF%E4%BD%8E%E7%A9%BA%E7%B6%93%E6%BF%9F%E6%96%B0%E6%9C%AA%E4%BE%86%E3%80%8B%E5%A0%B1%E5%91%8A%E7%99%BC%E5%B8%83%E6%9C%83))

[「根據本報告撰寫時的最新公開數據估算，預計到2050年，本港低空經濟產業的增加價值將達到約3,500億港元，而其中大部分來自配套服務。」]{lang="zh-Hant"} ([source](https://ourhkfoundation.org.hk/tc/events/%E3%80%8A%E6%8C%AF%E7%BF%85%E5%95%9F%E8%88%AA-%E2%80%94-%E9%96%8B%E5%89%B5%E9%A6%99%E6%B8%AF%E4%BD%8E%E7%A9%BA%E7%B6%93%E6%BF%9F%E6%96%B0%E6%9C%AA%E4%BE%86%E3%80%8B%E5%A0%B1%E5%91%8A%E7%99%BC%E5%B8%83%E6%9C%83))
:::

**unconstrained versus constrained market**  
Kind: Course  
Theoretical demand versus demand after legal, weather, infrastructure and acceptance barriers (NASA UAM framing). NASA UAM market study (2018). Week 4 / Week 9.

**Value chain**  
Kind: Course  
Stages from vehicle and infrastructure to operations and supporting services. Course. Week 1.

**Value of time**  
Kind: Course  
Shadow price of passenger or shipper time used inside generalised cost — lecture numbers stay off the public site. Course. Week 4.

**value-added versus 规模 (规模 (Mainland side only))**  
Kind: Course  
OHKF-style industry **value-added** is not the same metric as Mainland **规模** (scale) totals. OHKF (T3); NDRC / CCID scale figures. Week 9.

**yield**  
Kind: Course  
Revenue per traffic unit (e.g. per passenger-km or payload-km) — no classroom ticket prices on the public site. Course. Week 3.
